author: Acharya Ramanand
comment: The Yamuna Aarti at dusk brought tears of joy. We booked a wooden boat 30 mins before 7 PM.

author: Sunita Agarwal
comment: Arrived at 7:30 AM before morning curtains opened. No phones made entry smooth and peaceful.

author: Raghavendra Rao
comment: Parikrama via golf cart was a blessing for my elderly parents. The smart transit calculator was spot on.

author: Meenakshi Sharma
comment: The evening light show at Prem Mandir was divine. Loved the Mathura peda recommendations near Holi Gate!

author: Devendra Joshi
comment: Generated a 3-day itinerary through the portal. The sequential routing saved us hours of backtracking across towns.
